title: Gunning Fog Index Calculator
description: Compute the real Gunning Fog Index — the years of education needed to understand your text on first reading.
howto: Paste your text into the box.
Complex words (3+ syllables) are counted automatically.
Read the Fog Index: it estimates years of schooling needed to understand the text.

faqs.q: What is a good Fog Index?
faqs.a: Below 12 is ideal for general audiences (high-school level). Technical writing often scores 14–18; anything above 18 is very hard to read.
A word with 3 or more syllables, excluding proper nouns (capitalized words) and words lengthened only by -es, -ed or -ing endings.
